usedFor: Locate2u tracks deliveries and Facebook Messenger reaches customers, so “Shipment Status Change” can feed “Send Message from Page”.

bestTemplate.name: “Shipment Status Change” in Locate2u, then “Send Message from Page” in Facebook Messenger
bestTemplate.why: A status change is what the customer cares about, and the update goes out from your page.

watchOut: A message to a customer waits in Needs you for approval, so “Send Message from Page” is not instant.
